answer: Coordination Cost Ledger charges each identity in a shared action 0.01 credits plus 0.001 per co-signer at execution. A nebula swarm of 100 co-signers pays 0.11 credits per identity, so sybil total cost rises with cluster size. Cedar teams cannot evade it by splitting actions because distinct identities per block are recounted and charged. An attacker using nectar-funded accounts still pays that fee on every coordinated block.
